source: VICE: Fortnite Pirate Token Drop Rate Revealed – Normal and Treasure Hour Odds (Nov 7, 2026), reporting Epic's Fortnite Status schedule
text:
Epic Games has finally revealed the Fortnite Pirate Token drop rate, and it’s even rarer than many players thought. The Pirate Shop Token has a 1 in 137,500 chance of dropping per chest in a normal match. Those odds improve during Saturday’s Treasure Hours.
Epic Games has confirmed that the Fortnite Pirate Shop Token has a 1 in 137,500 chance of dropping per chest in a normal match. That works out to about 0.00073% per chest. In case you missed it, the highly-coveted token lets you claim every cosmetic in the Fortnite Item Shop for free for 14 days straight after redeeming it.
If you were wondering whether Epic nerfed the Pirate Token, the developer says the normal chest drop rates have stayed the same since Fortnite Treasure Hunters launched. More importantly, Epic Games also revealed that players will have a boosted chance of unlocking Pirate Shop access during the weekly Treasure Hours.
Epic Games has announced that the Fortnite Pirate Token has boosted drop rates during Treasure Hours, which run on Saturdays during the Treasure Hunters mini-season. The November 7 event has two sessions, with more Treasure Hours expected on November 14, 21, and 28.
| Treasure Hour date | First round | Second round | Pirate Token boost |
| November 7 | 11 AM–1 PM PT / 2–4 PM ET | 6–8 PM PT / 9–11 PM ET | 1.5× first round, 2× second round |
| November 14 | 11 AM–1 PM PT / 2–4 PM ET | 6–8 PM PT / 9–11 PM ET | 1.5× both rounds |
| November 21 | 11 AM–1 PM PT / 2–4 PM ET | 6–8 PM PT / 9–11 PM ET | 1.5× both rounds |
| November 28 | 11 AM–1 PM PT / 2–4 PM ET | 6–8 PM PT / 9–11 PM ET | 1.5× both rounds |
| December 5 | 11 AM–1 PM PT / 2–4 PM ET | 6–8 PM PT / 9–11 PM ET | 1.5× both rounds |
The normal Fortnite Pirate Token drop rate is 1 in 137,500 per chest. A 1.5× boost brings it to about 1 in 91,667, while a 2× boost brings it to 1 in 68,750.
